title: Knowing God
author: J.I. Packer
description: A classic exploration of God's character and attributes. Helps readers understand who God truly is, how He relates to His people, and how to grow in intimacy with Him.

title: Hearing God
author: Dallas Willard
description: A deep exploration of how to recognize and respond to God's voice in daily life. Teaches discernment and helps readers develop sensitivity to God's leading.

title: The Good Fight
author: John Bevere
description: Understanding spiritual warfare, God's purpose, and living out your faith with confidence despite opposition.

title: Blessings Overtake You
author: John Bevere
description: Explores God's heart toward His people and how blessings flow from obedience and right relationship with God.

title: Sex in a Broken World
author: Paul David Tripp
description: Honest, biblical exploration of sexuality and relationships. Addresses struggles with purity, lust, and building healthy relationships grounded in God's design.

title: Celebration of Discipline
author: Richard Foster
description: A transformative guide to spiritual disciplines. Covers prayer, meditation, fasting, solitude, service, and more. Foundational for deep spiritual growth.

title: The 21 Irrefutable Laws of Leadership
author: John Maxwell
description: Practical, principle-based approach to leadership. Essential reading for anyone leading a team, church group, or organization.

title: Developing the Leader Within You
author: John Maxwell
description: Focuses on personal development and growth as a leader. Practical steps to maximize your leadership potential.

title: The 5 Levels of Leadership
author: John Maxwell
description: Shows the progression of leadership growth from positional authority to genuine influence. Understand where you are and how to develop further.

title: The Psalms
author: David & Others
description: Raw, honest prayers expressing every human emotion—praise, lament, anger, hope. The Psalms model how to pray authentically.

title: Jesus's Teachings on Prayer (Compiled)
author: Jesus (Gospel accounts)
description: A collection of Jesus's direct teachings and parables about prayer, including the Lord's Prayer, teachings on faith, persistence, forgiveness, and praying in His name.
reference: See resources/jesus-teachings-on-prayer.md for full scripture references

title: The Lord's Prayer
author: Jesus
description: Matthew 6:9-13 — The prayer Jesus taught His disciples. A model for all Christian prayer.

title: Take Up Your Cross
author: Jesus
description: Matthew 16:24-25 — Jesus teaches that true life comes through self-denial and putting His kingdom above yourself.

title: Consider Others Better Than Yourselves
author: Paul
description: Philippians 2:3-4 — Paul's exhortation to humility and considering others' interests above your own.

title: Serve One Another in Love
author: Paul
description: Galatians 5:13 — Freedom in Christ is meant for serving others, not for selfish desires.

title: Think on These Things
author: Paul
description: Philippians 4:8 — Paul teaches that controlling your thoughts is key to spiritual freedom. Whatever is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, and admirable—meditate on these.

title: Your Body Is a Temple
author: Paul
description: 1 Corinthians 6:19 — Understanding the sanctity of your body and how honoring God means taking care of it.

title: As a Man Thinks in His Heart
author: Solomon
description: Proverbs 23:7 — Our thoughts shape who we are. Renewing your mind is essential to overcoming destructive habits.

title: Dead to Sin, Alive in Christ
author: Paul
description: Romans 6:11-14 — The foundational truth that through Christ, you have power over sin and addiction. You're not enslaved anymore.

title: Set Your Hope Fully on God
author: Peter
description: 1 Peter 1:13-16 — Peter teaches that holiness comes from placing complete trust in God, not in worldly desires.

title: As the Deer Pants for Water
author: David
description: Psalm 42 — An honest expression of doubt and longing for God. Addresses spiritual thirst and wrestling with faith.

title: What is Faith?
author: Unknown (likely Paul)
description: Hebrews 11:1-6 — A definition and exploration of faith. Foundational for understanding what it means to trust God.
